entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: dateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp only matches when c.Func.Name is one of the eight known date-component names lowerCall already filtered to reach lowerDateFn, minus "timestamp" (excluded by its own guard) — dateFnExpr always recognises the remainder, same reasoning as lowerDateFn's own identical dead branch (date_fns.go, cerberus issue #2498). The preceding `if b.ReturnBool` guard this branch used to sit behind moved into the shared shadowResolveFloatArmChecked helper (histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go, cerberus PR #2624's finding-10 ReturnBool-guard dedup) — it no longer appears in this function's own guard chain, but it played no part in this claim: the claim is purely about dateFnExpr's name coverage, unaffected by where the bool-modifier check lives.
